instruction: You are facing towards the window. Turn around and walk straightly in the hallway till you find a piano table in front of you. Slightly turn right and move towards the open room. Slightly turn left and enter into the open room. Slightly turn right and move towards the open door. Slightly turn right and walk straightly towards the wall which has a photo frame attached to it. Turn right and walk through the open door. Slightly turn right and walk straightly towards the wall by passing through the dining table. Now turn around and slightly turn left and walk all the way to the top of the stairs. Slightly turn left and move towards the open door. Turn around and walk straightly in the narrow passage till you find an open door in front of you. Walk through the open door. Now there is an another open door in front of you. Walk through the open door and enter into the room. Now you are standing at the entrance of a bedroom facing towards the glass window. That will be the end point.
